title: Jocky JK-SQ1
subtitle: 1-Puncher Pneumatic Snap-Attaching Machine with Protector Ring

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Jocky JK-SQ1 is a 1-puncher pneumatic snap-button attaching machine with an integrated protector ring — the standard industrial workhorse for attaching snap buttons to garments using compressed air. Driven by air rather than electricity, allowing operation without electrical power as long as compressed-air pressure is maintained.
applications: Snap button attaching on shirts, blouses, jeans, casual wear
Operations where air-driven tools are preferred for safety and cleanliness
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing, shirt production, casual wear, jeans finishing

overviewDescription: Made by Jocky (China; brand distinct from Jockey apparel — the snap-machine brand is Jocky per jockymachines.com / jockytech.com). The JK-SQ1 is the base 1-puncher model in the JK-SQ series. JK-Q1 is a sibling model in the same series. Pneumatic drive allows operation without electricity as long as compressed-air pressure is maintained, which the manufacturer highlights as a safety and energy-efficiency advantage.
